name: Viparyas
description:
A flower without seeds. 
Once the earth remembers, the Viparyas will bloom.
fullDescription: A flower without seeds. \nOnce the earth remembers, the Viparyas will bloom.\nThe forests of Sumeru are the seedbed of dreams, and the children of the forest spend a part of their lives walking in dreams. Some of them will later leave these forest dreams behind, but the forest will not forget them.
